extracted.intended_audience: prospective NHLBI trainees, mentors, and institutions seeking NHLBI training and career-development opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: Overview page describing NHLBI research training and career development opportunities across career stages, linking to specific funding mechanisms (e.g., F31) and notices (e.g., life event supplements). Useful for individuals and institutions looking for suitable programs and for aligning activities with NHLBI priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive research training and career development across career stages
rubrics_metrics.description: The NHLBI offers comprehensive research training and career development opportunities across career stages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an organizing principle: training and career-development offerings are intended to cover the full career continuum (from high school through mid-career/established investigators). Use the site to identify stage-appropriate programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities available to both individuals and institutions committed to advancing NHLBI-related science
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities are available to both individuals and institutions committed to advancing NHLBI-related science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility/targeting criterion: applicants (individuals or institutions) should demonstrate commitment to advancing heart, lung, blood, and sleep (HLBS) science when pursuing NHLBI training/career programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explore Training by Career Stage (stage-specific offerings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore Training by Career Stage: High School and Undergraduate Students; Postbaccalaureate; Graduate and Doctoral Students; Postdoctoral; Early Career; Mid-Career and Established Investigator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training and funding opportunities are organized and selected based on career stage. Users should identify the career-stage category that matches their situation to find appropriate programs and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: NHLBI’s Commitment to Workforce Development
rubrics_metrics.description: The NHLBI’s Commitment to Workforce Development: Sustaining a scientific workforce capable of accomplishing the NHLBI’s mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic criterion: NHLBI prioritizes workforce development activities that sustain capacity to carry out its mission. Training proposals and institutional programs should support long-term workforce sustainability and capacity building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with Strategic Vision objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Over the next decade, Strategic Vision objectives will serve as the NHLBI’s guide for moving heart, lung, blood, and sleep (HLBS) science forward, exploring research opportunities, and making investment decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and program planners should align training activities and proposals with NHLBI Strategic Vision objectives (see Objective 8 for training-related challenges and questions) to increase relevance for NHLBI investments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Featured funding mechanisms and supplements (example: F31 and Life Event Supplement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Featured Opportunities: F31 - Ruth L. Kirschstein Predoctoral Individual National Research Service Award; Life Event Supplement Funding to Promote Research Continuity (see NOT-OD-23-031 and NOT-OD-23-032).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete funding opportunities highlighted for specific audiences (e.g., F31 for graduate and doctoral students). The Life Event Supplement is intended to promote research continuity around life events. Users should review the linked notices and current funding opportunities to determine eligibility and application requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stay current with funding opportunities and notices for training
rubrics_metrics.description: View current funding opportunities and notices for training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural guidance: prospective applicants should regularly check current funding announcements and notices for updates, eligibility details, deadlines, and special programs (e.g., supplements).
